_comment: Images are accepted only from official bodies (museums, archives, space agencies, libraries, the Church) or from Wikimedia Commons, and only under a licence that allows reuse without share-alike. Hosts match by suffix. Pixabay, Pexels, Unsplash, Pinterest and Icons8 are NOT accepted: their licences cover the photograph, not the modern iconography or artwork in it. The Wikipedia article sites are never accepted as a source. Add a host only after reading the body's own reuse statement.
